template_name: High-Rise Commercial Mixed-Use Tower — Full Lifecycle

tasks.title: Define project vision and mixed-use brief
tasks.description: Establish the development vision for a 45-60 storey mixed-use tower including target tenancy mix (retail podium, office, residential/hotel), GFA targets, and brand positioning.
tasks.deliverables: Approved project brief and vision statement
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Brief signed off by developer board and design consultants engaged

tasks.title: Market demand study for retail, office and residential mix
tasks.description: Analyse catchment demand, office absorption rates, residential pricing, and retail footfall to validate the proposed tower tenancy mix and net saleable areas.
tasks.deliverables: Market demand and absorption study report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Study supports the proposed mix with sensitivity cases and is accepted by investment committee

tasks.title: Indicative massing and height feasibility study
tasks.description: Test indicative tower massing, height, and floor plate options against planning context, overshadowing of neighbouring occupied buildings, and daylight/sunlight constraints.
tasks.deliverables: Indicative massing options study with preferred scheme
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Preferred massing achievable within plausible planning envelope per pre-application advice

tasks.title: Preliminary capital cost benchmark per sqm
tasks.description: Benchmark high-rise tower construction cost per sqm GFA including basement, facade, and MEP allowances to frame the funding requirement.
tasks.deliverables: Order-of-magnitude capital cost estimate
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Benchmark range agreed with quantity surveyor and used in development appraisal

tasks.title: Funding structure and investor alignment
tasks.description: Structure senior debt/equity for the tower development, align drawdown profile with the 36-60 month programme, and secure investor commitments.
tasks.deliverables: Funding term sheet and drawdown schedule
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Funders committed with facility sized to cost plan plus contingency

tasks.title: Stakeholder engagement map including municipal planning authority
tasks.description: Map stakeholders: local authority / municipal planning authority, neighbours, utilities, heritage bodies, community groups; define engagement cadence.
tasks.deliverables: Stakeholder register and engagement plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All statutory consultees identified with named contacts

tasks.title: High-level master programme baseline (36-60 months)
tasks.description: Build the phase-gate master programme reflecting realistic durations for permitting, long-lead procurement, and floor-cycle construction for a high-rise tower.
tasks.deliverables: Level-1 master programme with phase gates
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Programme duration within 36-60 month range and accepted at investment gate

tasks.title: Investment committee go/no-go gate review
tasks.description: Formal gate decision to proceed to site acquisition and feasibility based on brief, market study, cost benchmark, and funding commitments.
tasks.deliverables: Signed gate decision record
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Formal approval minuted with funded Phase 1 budget released

tasks.title: Site acquisition, title and legal due diligence
tasks.description: Complete legal due diligence on title, easements, restrictive covenants affecting tower height or basement footprint, and execute acquisition.
tasks.deliverables: Due diligence report and completed acquisition contract
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Clean title secured with no unresolved covenant blocking the tower envelope

tasks.title: Ground investigation and geotechnical survey
tasks.description: Boreholes, trial pits, groundwater standpipes, and in-situ testing to depth of anticipated piled foundations and deep basement excavation.
tasks.deliverables: Factual and interpretive geotechnical reports
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Interpretive report recommends foundation and basement wall solutions with parameters for design

tasks.title: Land contamination survey and remediation strategy
tasks.description: Soil and groundwater contamination assessment across the site; develop land remediation strategy and disposal routes for contaminated arisings.
tasks.deliverables: Contamination assessment and outline remediation strategy
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Strategy endorsed by environmental regulator / local authority contaminated land officer

tasks.title: Topographic and utility condition survey
tasks.description: Detailed topo survey plus CCTV/trace of existing utilities crossing the basement and crane footprint; scope service diversions required for piling and excavation.
tasks.deliverables: Topo survey and utility constraint drawings
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All live services identified with diversion or protection strategy agreed with utility owners

tasks.title: Neighbour building condition surveys and party-wall pre-assessment
tasks.description: Dilapidation surveys of neighbouring occupied buildings within zone of influence of the deep basement; identify party-wall matters requiring agreements.
tasks.deliverables: Condition survey schedules and party-wall notice plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Baseline condition records signed by neighbour representatives; party-wall notices scoped

tasks.title: Planning pre-application consultation with local authority
tasks.description: Structured pre-application engagement with the local authority / municipal planning authority on height, massing, townscape, transport, and affordable/amenity obligations.
tasks.deliverables: Pre-application advice note and response action log
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Officer feedback confirms deliverable envelope or identifies resolvable constraints

tasks.title: Environmental impact assessment screening and scoping
tasks.description: EIA screening opinion request and, if required, scoping report covering wind, daylight, noise, ecology, and construction impacts of the tower.
tasks.deliverables: Screening opinion and EIA scoping report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Screening outcome determines whether full environmental statement is required and topics agreed

tasks.title: Foundation and deep basement feasibility study
tasks.description: Compare piled raft, large-diameter bored piles, and barrette pile options; assess secant vs contiguous piling for basement walls and dewatering implications.
tasks.deliverables: Foundation options report with recommended scheme
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Recommended scheme technically viable, buildable on constrained site, and costed

tasks.title: Tower crane strategy and urban site logistics concept
tasks.description: Define number, type (climbing luffing jib), positions, and climbing sequence of tower cranes given constrained city site, oversail limits, and neighbouring occupied buildings.
tasks.deliverables: Crane strategy and logistics concept plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Crane covers all required pick zones without prohibited oversail or achievable licences identified

tasks.title: Outline fire strategy concept for tall building
tasks.description: Establish evacuation strategy, firefighting cores, fire compartmentation principles, and smoke control concepts appropriate to a 45-60 storey tower.
tasks.deliverables: Outline fire strategy report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Concept endorsed by fire engineer and consistent with authority having jurisdiction guidance

tasks.title: Development appraisal and residual land value confirmation
tasks.description: Full financial appraisal combining cost plan, market study, EIA/mitigation costs, and remediation allowances to confirm scheme viability.
tasks.deliverables: Development appraisal model
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Appraisal meets funder hurdle returns with downside sensitivities tested

tasks.title: Site acquisition completion and legal close
tasks.description: Complete purchase, stamp/registration formalities, insurance handover, and possession arrangements enabling site investigations and early works access.
tasks.deliverables: Completion statement and possession certificate
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Developer has legal possession and site access rights for enabling investigations

tasks.title: Concept architectural design - floor plates and vertical circulation
tasks.description: Develop typical floor plates, core position and size, lobby, podium retail frontage, and vertical circulation stacks for the mixed-use tower.
tasks.deliverables: Concept design package with plans, sections, elevations
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Client sign-off on concept; net:gross efficiency meets brief targets

tasks.title: Structural scheme - core-and-slab with post-tensioned floors
tasks.description: Develop RC core and post-tensioned flat slab scheme including floor-to-floor heights, span logic, column grid, and podium transfer structure principles.
tasks.deliverables: Structural scheme report and framing plans
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Scheme achieves plate efficiencies and floor-cycle buildability; peer review passed

tasks.title: Foundation scheme - bored piling and secant pile basement walls
tasks.description: Advance the chosen foundation option to scheme design: pile loads, diameters, depths, and secant pile wall arrangement for the multi-level basement.
tasks.deliverables: Foundation scheme design report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Geotechnical check verifies pile capacities and wall stability with factors of safety met

tasks.title: Basement levels, excavation support and dewatering concept
tasks.description: Confirm basement level count, excavation support (propping/anchoring), groundwater control approach, and underpinning/interface strategy near neighbours.
tasks.deliverables: Basement and excavation support concept report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Movement predictions show neighbouring buildings remain within damage-limit thresholds

tasks.title: Facade concept - unitised curtain wall versus stick system
tasks.description: Trade off unitised curtain wall vs stick-built facade on cost, programme, crane logistics, and quality for the tower elevation; set performance specifications.
tasks.deliverables: Facade concept report and performance specification
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Selected system meets thermal, acoustic, and wind-load criteria with credible installation sequence

tasks.title: Vertical transportation study - elevator counts, speeds and zoning
tasks.description: Traffic analysis to size low/mid/high-rise elevator banks, shuttle lifts, service lifts, and escalators for podium retail; confirm core dimensions.
tasks.deliverables: Vertical transportation traffic report and lift schedule
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Waiting intervals and handling capacity meet grade for office/residential occupancy classes

tasks.title: MEP riser zoning and plant space allocation
tasks.description: Allocate primary and secondary MEP risers, floor plant zones, and rooftop/plant-floor space; verify riser sizes against floor demand for all tower levels.
tasks.deliverables: MEP riser zoning diagrams and plant space allocation plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every floor served within riser capacity; plant space verified against equipment schedules

tasks.title: Outline fire strategy report
tasks.description: Develop the outline fire strategy to support planning submission: evacuation modelling, firefighting shafts, smoke control, and facade fire performance intent.
tasks.deliverables: Outline fire strategy report for planning submission
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Reviewed by approving authority fire safety arm with no fundamental objections

tasks.title: Sustainability pre-assessment and BREEAM/LEED target setting
tasks.description: Run pre-assessment for the target rating, define energy strategy, embodied carbon targets for concrete frame and facade, and credit responsibility matrix.
tasks.deliverables: Sustainability strategy and pre-assessment scorecard
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Target rating achievable with costed credit plan accepted by client

tasks.title: Planning submission drawing package
tasks.description: Assemble and submit the planning application package: massing, elevations, materials (including cladding intent), landscaping, transport, and daylight/wind reports.
tasks.deliverables: Submitted planning application with validation certificate
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Application validated by local authority / municipal planning authority and registered

tasks.title: Pre-construction cost plan and elemental estimates
tasks.description: Elemental cost plan covering substructure/piling, concrete frame, facade, MEP, fit-out, preliminaries for constrained urban logistics, and risk allowances.
tasks.deliverables: Elemental pre-construction cost plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cost plan reconciles to funding envelope with contingency percentage stated

tasks.title: Construction methodology statement - core jump and crane climbing
tasks.description: Document buildability methodology: self-climbing core formwork jump cycle, post-tensioned slab cycle, tower crane climbing sequence, and basement construction staging.
tasks.deliverables: Construction methodology statement
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Methodology reviewed by temporary works engineer and insurer; cycle assumptions evidenced

tasks.title: Long-lead procurement register initiation
tasks.description: Establish the long-lead register with target order dates for elevators, curtain wall, tower cranes, switchgear, generators, and facade access units.
tasks.deliverables: Long-lead procurement register with dates and owners
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every item with lead time >6 months has an order date compatible with the master programme

tasks.title: Stage gate design review - concept freeze
tasks.description: Independent gateway review of concept design, cost plan, methodology, and planning submission readiness prior to detailed design release.
tasks.deliverables: Gate review report with actions closed
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Gate passed formally; concept declared frozen and change control activated

tasks.title: Detailed architectural design development
tasks.description: Develop architecture to construction-issue level: facade setting-out, core detailing, podium retail interfaces, and residential/office fit-out standards.
tasks.deliverables: Detailed architectural drawing and specification issue
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Drawing register complete for building control submission with consultant sign-offs

tasks.title: Detailed structural design - post-tensioned slabs and transfers
tasks.description: Full design of post-tensioned floor plates including stressing sequence, anchorage zones, punching shear reinforcement, and podium transfer structure design.
tasks.deliverables: Structural calculation pack and construction-issue drawings
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Independent category III check completed; PT supplier shop drawings approved

tasks.title: Piling and basement wall detailed design
tasks.description: Detailed design of bored piles and secant pile basement wall including reinforcement cages, toe levels into competent strata, and watertightness detailing.
tasks.deliverables: Piling and basement wall construction drawings
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Design verified against ground investigation data; checker sign-off obtained

tasks.title: Structural steel connection design for steel elements
tasks.description: Design bolted/welded connections for structural steel elements at podium, transfer, and roof plant levels; coordinate with concrete frame interfaces.
tasks.deliverables: Steel connection design drawings and calc pack
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Connections designed for erection forces as well as permanent loads; fabricator review passed

tasks.title: Detailed facade engineering - thermal and structural glazing calculations
tasks.description: Unitised curtain wall detailed engineering: wind load, thermal transmittance, condensation, acoustic, seismic movement, and fire spread performance calculations.
tasks.deliverables: Facade engineering calculation pack and system drawings
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Calculations meet specified performance; mock-up test scope agreed with test house

tasks.title: Detailed fire strategy and smoke control design
tasks.description: Detailed fire strategy for approval: smoke control and stair pressurisation systems, firefighting lift provisions, compartmentation, and cladding fire performance specification.
tasks.deliverables: Detailed fire strategy report and smoke control design
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fire strategy approval received from authority having jurisdiction

tasks.title: MEP detailed design - risers, plant rooms and builders work
tasks.description: Coordinate MEP detailed design through all risers and plant rooms; issue builders-work openings and structural penetrations coordinated in the federated model.
tasks.deliverables: Coordinated MEP construction drawings and penetration drawings
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Federated model clash-free at LOD 350; builders-work drawings issued to structure team

tasks.title: Building regulations / building control submission
tasks.description: Submit full plans application to building control body covering structure, fire, drainage, accessibility, and energy for the tower; manage queries to approval.
tasks.deliverables: Building control approval notice
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Full plans approval or conditional approval with all conditions listed and owned

tasks.title: Full planning permission determination and condition discharge
tasks.description: Manage the planning application through determination, committee if required, secure consent, then discharge pre-commencement conditions (materials, CTMP, archaeology).
tasks.deliverables: Planning permission decision notice and condition discharge approvals
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Permission granted; all pre-commencement conditions discharged before site start

tasks.title: Party-wall agreements execution with neighbouring owners
tasks.description: Serve notices, appoint party-wall surveyors, and execute party-wall awards with all neighbouring owners affected by basement excavation and piling vibration.
tasks.deliverables: Executed party-wall awards for all affected boundaries
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No outstanding dissent; awards allow scheduled piling and excavation methods

tasks.title: Highway oversail, hoarding and street works permit applications
tasks.description: Apply for crane oversail/scaffold licences over public highway, hoarding permits, and street works licences for the constrained city site.
tasks.deliverables: Approved highway, hoarding, and oversail licences
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Licences granted covering full construction period with fees paid

tasks.title: Deep excavation temporary works design certification
tasks.description: Temporary works design for basement excavation support: props, anchors, raking struts, and monitoring regime; independent temporary works category check.
tasks.deliverables: Certified temporary works design and monitoring specification
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Temporary works coordinator signs off design check certificate; instrumentation plan approved

tasks.title: Dewatering and water discharge permit application
tasks.description: Apply for abstraction/discharge consent for basement dewatering; agree discharge water quality limits and monitoring with environmental regulator.
tasks.deliverables: Discharge permit with monitoring conditions
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Permit granted covering full dewatering duration with compliant treatment train specified

tasks.title: Detailed design stage gate sign-off
tasks.description: Gateway review confirming design completeness, approvals status, and construction-readiness of information before major procurement commitments.
tasks.deliverables: Stage gate 3 sign-off certificate
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All critical-path approvals held or on track; residual design risks logged with owners

tasks.title: Main contractor procurement strategy and tender award
tasks.description: Run competitive tender for the main contractor / construction manager, evaluate on capability for high-rise core-and-slab work, and award.
tasks.deliverables: Executed main contract with programme and cost target
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Award within budget; contractor's construction programme integrated with master plan

tasks.title: Tower crane package tender and award
tasks.description: Procure climbing luffing-jib tower cranes including bases, climbing schedule, maintenance, and operator supply matched to the core jump sequence.
tasks.deliverables: Tower crane supply contract with delivery and climbing schedule
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cranes available on site per programme; climbing sequence validated against structure design

tasks.title: Piling subcontractor award
tasks.description: Award the piling package for bored piles and secant pile basement wall including rig selection for constrained access and noise/vibration limits near neighbours.
tasks.deliverables: Executed piling subcontract with method statement
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Subcontractor demonstrates relevant deep-basement track record and plant availability

tasks.title: Structural steel fabricator award
tasks.description: Award structural steel fabrication and erection for podium, transfer, and roof structures including connection design responsibility and fire protection.
tasks.deliverables: Steelwork subcontract with fabrication schedule
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fabricator accredited; mill certificates and welding QA regime contractualised

tasks.title: Post-tensioning specialist award
tasks.description: Award the PT package covering design assist, strand supply, installation, stressing, and grouting with QA records for every post-tensioned slab.
tasks.deliverables: PT specialist subcontract with design-assist scope
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Specialist approved by structural engineer; stressing and grouting QA protocol agreed

tasks.title: Self-climbing core formwork and falsework award
tasks.description: Procure the self-climbing core formwork system and slab falsework, including climb-rate engineering matched to concrete strength gain and crane availability.
tasks.deliverables: Formwork/falsework supply contract with climb engineering
tasks.acceptance_criteria: System engineered for target core jump cycle with temporary works checks complete

tasks.title: Curtain wall fabricator and installer award
tasks.description: Award unitised curtain wall manufacture and installation including prototype/mock-up testing programme and factory quality audits.
tasks.deliverables: Curtain wall contract with mock-up test plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fabricator passes technical and financial vetting; mock-up dates locked to programme

tasks.title: Elevator and escalator supplier award - long-lead order
tasks.description: Place the long-lead order for high-speed elevators, shuttles, service lifts, and podium escalators; lock delivery dates against shaft handover sequence.
tasks.deliverables: Executed lift/escalator supply contract with delivery milestones
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Delivery dates contractually committed and loaded into master programme critical path

tasks.title: MEP package subcontractor award
tasks.description: Award mechanical, electrical, and plumbing subcontract including riser installation methodology, prefabrication strategy, and commissioning responsibilities.
tasks.deliverables: MEP subcontract with installation and commissioning scope split
tasks.acceptance_criteria: MEP contractor resources plan matches riser installation rate behind floor cycles

tasks.title: Ready-mix concrete supply framework agreement
tasks.description: Establish supply framework with multiple batching plants, continuity/back-up plan, pour scheduling windows, and special mixes for post-tensioned slabs.
tasks.deliverables: Concrete framework agreement with dual-plant continuity plan
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Guaranteed pour capacity covers peak slab cycle demand with nominated back-up plant

tasks.title: Cladding panel supplier award
tasks.description: Award terracotta/metal/GRC cladding panel supply for podium and amenity areas including fire performance certification and import logistics plan.
tasks.deliverables: Cladding supply contract with certification dossier requirements
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fire classification certificates and import schedule committed in contract

tasks.title: Basement waterproofing specialist award
tasks.description: Award waterproofing/tanking system design-and-install for basement slabs and walls with warranty-backed installation and integrity testing regime.
tasks.deliverables: Waterproofing subcontract with system warranty
tasks.acceptance_criteria: System graded appropriate to basement use class; installer certified by manufacturer

tasks.title: Insurance, performance guarantees and retention review
tasks.description: Place construction all-risks, latent defects, and third-party insurance; review performance guarantees, retentions, and liquidated damages across awarded packages.
tasks.deliverables: Insurance certificates and guarantee schedule
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cover in force from mobilisation; LD regimes aligned to developer commitments

tasks.title: Procurement closeout - contracts and bonds executed
tasks.description: Reconcile all awarded packages against cost plan, confirm bonds/guarantees lodged, and close the procurement phase with a complete contract register.
tasks.deliverables: Final contract register and procurement closeout report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 100% critical-path packages executed; no unbudgeted exposure open

tasks.title: Site mobilisation, hoarding and welfare setup
tasks.description: Mobilise the constrained urban site: hoarding to permitted line, gates, wheel wash, tower crane base preparation, offices, and welfare accommodation.
tasks.deliverables: Mobilised site with permits displayed and logistics live
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Site compliant with HSE induction requirements; deliveries routing per CTMP

tasks.title: Tower crane base construction and first erection
tasks.description: Construct crane bases/foundations and erect the first tower cranes with third-party examination, load testing, and operator briefing on lift zones.
tasks.deliverables: Erected and certified tower cranes
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Cranes hold current thorough-examination certificates; exclusion zones demarcated

tasks.title: Land remediation and contaminated soil removal
tasks.description: Execute the remediation strategy: excavation, segregation, treatment or licensed disposal of contaminated soils, and verification reporting.
tasks.deliverables: Remediation verification report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Verification data accepted by regulator; clean-cover or gas protection measures installed

tasks.title: Secant/contiguous piling works to basement perimeter
tasks.description: Install guide walls and secant/contiguous piles around the basement perimeter and bored piles to foundations, managing vibration near neighbouring buildings.
tasks.deliverables: Completed piling with as-built pile records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All piles installed to design toe level and tolerance; daily vibration monitoring within limits

tasks.title: Pile integrity testing and acceptance
tasks.description: Low-strain integrity testing of all piles plus selected static/ODEN load tests; review anomalies and remediate defective piles before excavation proceeds.
tasks.deliverables: Integrity test report with acceptance sign-off
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 100% piles tested; any Class C/D anomalies remediated and retested successfully

tasks.title: Bulk excavation and basement dig with dewatering
tasks.description: Progressive bulk excavation to basement formation with dewatering running, prop installation per temporary works sequence, and movement monitoring of neighbours.
tasks.deliverables: Excavated basement to formation with support installed
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Neighbour and wall movements within predicted amber/red triggers; dewatering maintaining dry dig

tasks.title: Basement waterproofing and tanking installation
tasks.description: Install waterproofing membrane/tanking to base slab and walls with protection boards, waterstops at joints, and flood-test verification of vulnerable zones.
tasks.deliverables: Installed and protected waterproofing system
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Zero uncontrolled water ingress at handover of each zone; installer QA records complete

tasks.title: Raft and base slab concrete pours
tasks.description: Execute staged mass concrete pours to the raft/base slab with thermal control, pour sequencing, and cube/cylinder strength testing regime.
tasks.deliverables: Completed base slab with pour cards and test results
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Strength results meet specification; thermal differentials within limits; no cold joints

tasks.title: Basement structure concrete frame construction
tasks.description: Build basement columns, walls, and suspended slabs level by level up to ground, integrating riser sleeves and builders-work openings from coordinated drawings.
tasks.deliverables: Basement concrete frame complete to ground level
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Verticality and level tolerances met; all embedded openings match MEP coordinated drawings

tasks.title: Ground floor slab and transfer structure construction
tasks.description: Construct the ground-floor slab and podium transfer structure combining post-tensioned concrete and structural steel elements supporting the tower above.
tasks.deliverables: Transfer structure complete with steelwork erected
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Hold point inspection passed before loading transfer; steel bolting/torque records complete

tasks.title: Core jump commencement - self-climbing formwork cycle
tasks.description: Assemble and strike the first core jumps with the self-climbing system, establishing the repeatable core jump cycle ahead of floor slab production.
tasks.deliverables: Core jump cycle established with cycle-time baseline
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Three consecutive jumps completed within planned cycle time

tasks.title: Tower crane climbing sequence operations
tasks.description: Execute scheduled tower crane climbs tied to core and slab levels, with wind limits, exclusion management, and engineer supervision at each climb.
tasks.deliverables: Climb records and updated crane standing data
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Each climb completed within wind limits with signed engineer approval

tasks.title: First post-tensioned typical floor slabs - install, stress and grout
tasks.description: Deliver the first typical post-tensioned slab floors: deck install, tendon placing, concrete pour, controlled stressing at strength, and duct grouting.
tasks.deliverables: First PT floors complete with stressing and grouting records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Stressing elongations within +/-7% of calculated; grout cubes pass; QA records per slab

tasks.title: Slab cycle optimisation to target floor cycle time
tasks.description: Tune labour, formwork sets, crane hooks, and concrete pour windows to hit and sustain the target days-per-floor cycle for the repetitive tower floors.
tasks.deliverables: Cycle-time dashboard and optimisation actions log
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Rolling average floor cycle at or better than target over four consecutive floors

tasks.title: Structural steel erection at podium and transfer levels
tasks.description: Erect and connect structural steel elements at podium, transfer, and amenity levels, coordinating with concrete frame tolerances and crane pick plans.
tasks.deliverables: Erected and connected steelwork with torque records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Alignment within tolerance; all connections inspected and signed off before decking

tasks.title: Substructure completion gate - waterproofing integrity verification
tasks.description: Formal gate verifying basement watertightness, monitoring stability, and backfill/protection completion before superstructure production ramps up.
tasks.deliverables: Substructure completion certificate
tasks.acceptance_criteria: No active leaks; monitoring trends stable; gate signed by engineer and contractor

tasks.title: Superstructure concrete frame repetitive floor cycles
tasks.description: Drive repetitive floor production: form, fix rebar and tendons, pour, stress post-tensioned slabs, strip, and move up — sustaining the target cycle to roof.
tasks.deliverables: Concrete frame topped out at roof level
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Floor cycle variance within +/-10% of target; zero structural NCRs carried unresolved

tasks.title: Core jump progression tracking to roof level
tasks.description: Track core jump productivity, concrete strength gain dependencies, and crane climb interlocks weekly to keep core ahead of floors by required lead floors.
tasks.deliverables: Core progression tracker with look-ahead
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Core maintains minimum lead floors over slab production throughout

tasks.title: Post-tensioned slab stressing and grouting QA surveillance
tasks.description: Independent QA surveillance of every PT stressing operation and grout pour across all floors, with calibration certificates and elongation record audits.
tasks.deliverables: PT QA surveillance reports per floor
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 100% stressing records audited; any out-of-tolerance elongation investigated and dispositioned

tasks.title: Tower crane climb-ups, tie-ins and final standing review
tasks.description: Continue crane climbs with building tie-ins as height increases; review standing/free-standing heights against design at every stage.
tasks.deliverables: Climb and tie-in records to final height
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All climbs engineer-approved; tie-in weld/bolt inspections passed

tasks.title: Curtain wall unit delivery and floor-by-floor installation
tasks.description: Receive, inspect, and install unitised curtain wall modules floor by floor behind the frame using the tower crane or hoists, maintaining the closing-in sequence.
tasks.deliverables: Installed curtain wall zones with per-unit QA records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Installation tolerances met; damaged units quarantined; sequence keeps pace with frame

tasks.title: Facade zone air and water infiltration testing
tasks.description: Conduct on-building air permeability and water spray tests on completed facade zones per ASTM/AAMA-equivalent methods; rectify and retest failures.
tasks.deliverables: Facade test reports per zone
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Every zone passes specified air/water performance before being declared weathertight

tasks.title: Cladding panel installation to podium and amenity areas
tasks.description: Install terracotta/metal/GRC cladding to podium levels with verified subframe fixings, cavity barriers, and fire-stopping at every compartment line.
tasks.deliverables: Installed cladding with fixing and fire-barrier records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fixing pull-out tests pass; cavity barrier installation photographed and signed per zone

tasks.title: MEP riser installation and vertical continuity
tasks.description: Install primary/secondary MEP risers — pipework, busbar, dampers, cabling — floor by floor maintaining vertical continuity and pressure-test as you go.
tasks.deliverables: Risers installed and progressively tested
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Sectional pressure/continuity tests passed per riser per zone

tasks.title: MEP riser coordination clash resolution
tasks.description: Run weekly federated-model clash reviews resolving riser, structure, and facade bracket conflicts before they reach site; track clash burn-down.
tasks.deliverables: Clash log with burn-down trend to zero critical clashes
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Zero unresolved critical clashes two weeks ahead of affected installation

tasks.title: Elevator shaft handover and rail installation
tasks.description: Hand over elevator shafts from structure to lift contractor at defined levels: plumbness survey, brackets, rails, counterweight guides, and machine beams.
tasks.deliverables: Shaft handover certificates per lift group
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Shaft plumbness within manufacturer tolerance; handover signed by lift specialist

tasks.title: Elevator and escalator installation and functional testing
tasks.description: Install cars, machines, ropes/controllers and podium escalators; run functional and safety-circuit tests ahead of formal commissioning.
tasks.deliverables: Installed lifts/escalators with functional test logs
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All safety circuits proven; units run reliably in test mode without faults

tasks.title: Internal fit-out - drywall, ceilings and raised floors
tasks.description: Fit out office/residential floors: partitions, acoustic ceilings, raised access floors, and riser terminations, following facade close-in per zone.
tasks.deliverables: Fit-out complete per floor zone
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Zone sign-offs with room data sheets verified against specification

tasks.title: Facade close-in and slab-to-facade void sealing
tasks.description: Seal slab-to-facade perimeter voids with fire-rated closers and weather seals; verify continuity of compartmentation at every floor edge.
tasks.deliverables: Sealed perimeter with fire-stop inspection records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 100% perimeter bays inspected and photographed; no gaps in fire barrier continuity

tasks.title: Roof plant installation and crane dismantle preparation
tasks.description: Lift and set roof-level chillers, AHUs, cooling towers, and screen enclosure; prepare crane dismantling plan including pick studies for remaining heavy lifts.
tasks.deliverables: Roof plant set with dismantle plan approved
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All heavy lifts completed before crane reduction; plant aligned and anchored

tasks.title: Tower crane final dismantle and removal
tasks.description: Dismantle tower cranes section by section using auxiliary mobile cranes per engineered sequence; reinstate roof and make-good crane tie locations.
tasks.deliverables: Cranes removed with make-good inspection records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Dismantle completed without incident; roof penetrations made good and waterproofed

tasks.title: Perimeter scaffolding strike and external works start
tasks.description: Strike perimeter scaffold and mast-climbers after facade completion; commence hard landscaping and podium external works.
tasks.deliverables: Scaffold struck and external works commenced
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Facade survey confirms no scaffold-abuse damage; highways reinstatement started per licence

tasks.title: Fit-out second fix - doors, ironmongery and finishes
tasks.description: Complete second-fix joinery, doors, ironmongery, sanitaryware, and decorative finishes across office, residential, and retail tenancies.
tasks.deliverables: Second-fix complete with finish samples approved
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Room completion certificates issued per tenancy zone

tasks.title: Facade completion inspection and snagging
tasks.description: Walk the completed facade bay by bay recording snags — gasket, anodising, sealant, alignment — and drive closure before handover.
tasks.deliverables: Facade snag list with closure tracking
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All Category A/B facade snags closed prior to Phase 7 entry

tasks.title: MEP systems pre-commissioning - flushing, pressure and IR tests
tasks.description: Static completion of MEP: chemical flushing of pipework, pressure tests, cable insulation resistance, and dead/live testing per system.
tasks.deliverables: Pre-commissioning certificates per system
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All systems pass static tests and are declared ready for dynamic commissioning

tasks.title: Fire alarm cause and effect testing
tasks.description: Witness full cause-and-effect matrix testing of the addressable fire alarm network across all floors, interfacing with smoke control, lifts, and access control.
tasks.deliverables: Witnessed cause-and-effect test records
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 100% matrix cells demonstrated and witnessed by fire engineer and authority representative

tasks.title: Sprinkler and hydrant hydrostatic testing
tasks.description: Hydrostatically test the sprinkler systems floor by floor and the rising mains/hydrants, including fire pump churn and duty tests.
tasks.deliverables: Hydro test certificates and pump test curves
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Two-hour holding at test pressure with zero loss; pump curves meet design duty

tasks.title: Smoke control and stair pressurisation system testing
tasks.description: Performance-test smoke extract fans, stair/lobby pressurisation, and automatic damper sequences against the detailed fire strategy design values.
tasks.deliverables: Smoke control performance test report
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Measured pressures/airflows within fire strategy tolerances on every zone scenario

tasks.title: Elevator and escalator commissioning including safe-mode tests
tasks.description: Commission high-speed elevators: dynamic balancing, levelling, door protection, firefighter recall mode, and escalator safety device chain tests.
tasks.deliverables: Lift commissioning certificates and handover files
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All units pass safety tests including firefighter/evacuation modes; ride quality within spec

tasks.title: BMS point-to-point commissioning and integration
tasks.description: Point-to-point verify every BMS input/output across plant and floors; integrate fire, lifts, metering, and tenant submetering dashboards.
tasks.deliverables: BMS points schedule 100% verified and integrated
tasks.acceptance_criteria: All points proven correct end-to-end; integration alarms tested and logged

tasks.title: Building control final inspection and completion certificate
tasks.description: Host the building control body final inspection across structure, fire, accessibility, and energy evidence; resolve observations and obtain the completion certificate.
tasks.deliverables: Building control completion certificate
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Certificate issued with no outstanding material contraventions

tasks.title: Snagging and handover walkdown with client and operators
tasks.description: Joint room-by-room snagging walkdowns with developer-client and incoming operators; categorise and drive closure to practical completion.
tasks.deliverables: Snagging database with practical completion sign-off
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Practical completion declared with agreed minor items scheduled within DLP

tasks.title: O&M manuals, as-builts and asset data handover
tasks.description: Compile and hand over O&M manuals, as-built drawings, commissioning records, warranties, and COBie/CAFM asset data for stratified assets.
tasks.deliverables: Complete handover documentation pack
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Operator accepts documentation as complete and usable for facilities management

tasks.title: Defects liability period mobilisation and soft landings support
tasks.description: Stand up the DLP defect management regime, seasonal commissioning visits, and occupier aftercare across retail, office, and residential assets.
tasks.deliverables: DLP plan with defect triage SLA and seasonal commissioning calendar
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Defect response SLAs live; first seasonal commissioning visit scheduled and resourced
